Linux content-blocker bridge page and script names.

The Web Store button label all three engines draw (chromium-helium-branding.patch's extstore fixup on the Mac and Windows, ac_linux_web_store.cc on Linux), only where a check or acceptance step asserts what the engine shows; the app's own relabel script (webStore.ts and its Linux copy in hostPageScripts.ts) and its settings copy are app-owned and rename together.
